title: feature_ready Kafka message
description: Schema for messages published to the feature_ready topic by Feature Service. Consumers must treat all feature fields as required; absent fields indicate a producer bug.

session_id.description: UUID of the session this feature vector belongs to

variant.description: Ablation / model variant. Determines which feature fields are populated.

computed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the feature vector was computed

window_seconds.description: Rolling window length in seconds, or null for session-level aggregation

features.description: All 76 feature fields. Fields absent from the active ablation set are emitted at their default values.

visit_count.description: Number of previous visits by this visitor

url.description: Full URL of the landing page

path.description: URL path of the landing page

referrer.description: HTTP referrer of the landing request

time_on_page_sec.description: Mean time spent per page in seconds (event-derived)

max_scroll_pct.description: Mean maximum scroll depth across pages (0–100)

tab_hidden_count.description: Number of times the browser tab was hidden

tab_hidden_ms.description: Total time the tab was hidden in milliseconds

form_fields_count.description: Total form fields visible on the page

form_fields_touched.description: Number of form fields the visitor interacted with

bounce.description: True when the session contained only one page view

is_logged_in.description: True if the visitor was authenticated at any point

selected_quantity.description: Product quantity selected by the visitor

detected_page_type.description: Page type classifier output: pdp | plp | cart | checkout | home

product_slug.description: URL slug of the primary product viewed

checkout_step_detected.description: Highest checkout funnel step reached (0 = none)

search_query_from_url.description: Search query extracted from URL parameters

is_order_success.description: True if an order-success event was fired in this session

product_id.description: ID of the primary product interacted with

product_price.description: Price of the primary product in local currency

product_category.description: Merchant-defined category of the primary product

selected_size.description: Size variant selected by the visitor

search_query.description: In-site search query entered by the visitor

js_error.description: Number of JavaScript errors captured in the session

page_view_count.description: Raw page_view event count from T2 event stream

coupon_entered.description: True if a coupon code was entered at checkout

action_detected.description: Last notable action label from the event classifier

cart_value.description: Total value of items currently in cart

cart_item_count.description: Number of distinct line items in cart

checkout_step.description: Current checkout step from the checkout_step event

payment_method.description: Payment method selected: qpay | socialpay | card | etc.

shipping_method.description: Shipping option selected by the visitor

order_total.description: Final order amount including shipping and discounts

discount_code.description: Discount/coupon code applied to the order

is_sale.description: True if the primary product was on sale

product_stock.description: Stock count of the primary product

cart_churn_count.description: Number of times items were removed from the cart

page_views.description: Session-service computed page view count (distinct from page_view_count T2 raw)

end_reason.description: How the session ended: timeout | unload | purchase

abandoned.description: True if the session was classified as abandoned by the session service

event_count.description: Total events in the session sequence (derived from event_sequence length)

is_mobile.description: True when device_type is mobile or phone

frustration_index.description: Computed: weighted combination of rage_click, js_error, scroll_up, tab_hidden signals

commitment_depth.description: Computed: how deeply the visitor engaged with the purchase funnel

price_hesitation_score.description: Computed: signals of price sensitivity (copy events, category quartile, quantity changes)

hedonic_ratio.description: Computed: fraction of events on hedonic (fashion/beauty/etc.) categories

mongolian_trust_barrier.description: Computed: trust friction score specific to Mongolian e-commerce context

time_to_first_action_ms.description: Computed: milliseconds from session start to first meaningful interaction

avg_price_in_session.description: Computed: mean product price across all product events in the session

dist_product_count.description: Computed: number of distinct products viewed in the session

hour_sin.description: Computed: sine encoding of session start hour (cyclic temporal feature)

hour_cos.description: Computed: cosine encoding of session start hour (cyclic temporal feature)

dow_sin.description: Computed: sine encoding of day-of-week (cyclic temporal feature)

dow_cos.description: Computed: cosine encoding of day-of-week (cyclic temporal feature)

mouse_distance.description: Mouse tracking: total cursor travel distance in pixels

mouse_speed.description: Mouse tracking: mean cursor speed in pixels/second

direction_changes.description: Mouse tracking: number of direction reversals (feeds Visibility Graph service)

cart_abandonment_signal.description: ML target: True when cart has items and session ended without a purchase

ablation_sets._comment: Controls which features are populated in the 'features' object. Set via FEATURE_SET env var. Fields outside the active set are emitted at their default values.
